system.description: Fire gives birth to smoke. Smoke gives birth to hazards. When you cast a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword that would inflict ranks of Burned, you cause your flames to instead be overcome with a gout of gray and white smoke. All affected creature that would gain ranks of Burned can instead gain an equal number of ranks of Envenomed. Creatures resistant or immune to Poison damage do not have advantage on saving throws to resist ranks of Envenomed granted by this feature.
